summary: The customer called in frustrated because their new 5G router was not connecting to the internet despite following the instructions. The agent guided the customer through troubleshooting steps including a power cycle and a factory reset, and eventually discovered that the line activation was missing on the system. The agent manually activated the line, successfully resolving the issue.
